faye: Heads-up from todays onboard for agnosia13b int8. Strong cost savings but a measurable drop on multi-hop retrieval QA.
omar: Numbers plz.
faye: p50 gen: 130ms -> 103ms, p95: 610 -> 620. cost/1M tokens: $138 -> $102. Multi-hop QA EM fell 5.2% (from 68.1 -> 62.9) on our 4k slice.
vince: Oof. Any sign its only cold-start noise?
faye: Warm-only runs still show ~4.7% EM drop. KV cache helps latency but not the recall hit.
tara: What about semantic metrics or human checks?
faye: ROUGE-L down 2.6 pts, embed-cosine mean -0.014. Human spot 250 samples: acceptable answers 85% -> 78%, hallucinations up 4 -> 11.
faye: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) cheap confidence classifier to gate high-risk queries to fp16, 2) per-layer mixed precision (keep final MLP fp16), 3) soft-logit scaling.
ovar: Love the gate. Can we define "high-risk"? I propose query_length > 1500 OR retrieval_count > 3 OR endpoint tag X-LLM-SLA:priority=high.
vince: Unit econ sketch: assume 120k daily queries avg 1.1k tokens. fp16 baseline ~$17.6k/day, full-int8 ~$13.0k/day. Gate 18% to fp16 -> blended ~$14.9k/day (saves ~15%). Expected weighted EM hit ~0.9% if gate catches most high-risk.
tara: Also recommend canary 3% int8-only, then enable gate at 18% for 24h, monitor EM delta and hallucination rate. Add rollback: hallucination_rate > 3pp OR EM drop > 1.2pp.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: agnosia13b-int8-canary will be created by vince on 2026-04-18T09:30:00Z.
faye: Command I used: ```bash
ri eval run --model agnosia13b-int8 --suite multi-hop-retrieval --samples 4000 --kv-cache warm --out artifacts/agnosia_int8_multi.json
```
ovar: Please upload artifacts and human notes. I'll run bootstrap significance and cost sims.
tara: For GTN: call pattern "confidence-gated hybrid" with default high-risk rule and unit econ. I'll draft a short blurb and thresholds.
faye: Owners: faye -> run int6 sweep 1k samples + temp-scaling grid; vince -> create canary and alerts; omar -> significance + cost sims; tara -> GTN blurb. Will post artifacts when uploaded.
faye: Quick ask: infra parity check for Dedicated/private kernels before GA. Seen small kernel diffs in past.
vince: Noted  we'll add per-cluster perf profile to model catalog.
faye: Thanks all, will ping updates. :thumbsup:
